gap_details.2011-2012: No roster. upstate.edu practice residents.php served the Dec-2010 (2010-11) list unchanged in every capture to 2013-07 and in Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2012 (2012-02) and 2013-20. cnyneurosurgery.org: no captures before 2013-08, CC 2012/2013-20 0 records. Reconstructed 9 (bracketed by 2010-11 and 2013-14, or graduates page). Not reconstructed: Walter Jacobsen (PGY4 2010-11, never seen again, not on graduates list), David Ferrone and Gentian Toshkezi (first seen 2013-14; entry year ambiguous). PHASE 2: Upstate GME 'Resident Report' Fall 2011 newsletter (https://web.archive.org/web/20121126195919/http://www.upstate.edu/gme/pdf/resident_report_fall2011.pdf) 'Welcome New Residents - Neurosurgery: Alexa Bodman, David Ferrone' = the full 2011 intake; Ferrone added (PGY2, matching PGY4 in 2013-14). Fall 2010 issue lists only Michael Galgano (2010 class of 1 confirmed). Jacobsen on Albany roster PGY5 Jan-2012 -> transferred out 2011.
gap_details.2012-2013: No roster (same evidence as 2011-12). Reconstructed 7. The 2012 intern class is unobservable: Venita Simpson (PGY2 2013-14) and possibly Toshkezi entered then; neither reconstructed. PHASE 2: Toshkezi reconstructed at PGY1 (PGY2 July 2013; Upstate neurosurgery affiliation on paper received 2012-06, PMID 23202580; earlier BU research affiliation, so not a residency transfer; grad 2018). Ferrone PGY3 added. Simpson (Georgetown MD) was the other 2012 entrant but is not reconstructed (not bracketed / not an Upstate graduate). GME Fall 2012 and Fall 2013 newsletters have no welcome list.
gap_details.2014-2015: No Aug-Jan capture with new content (Oct/Dec-2014 and Feb-2015 still showed the July-2013 list). March-2015 capture used; content-dated 2014-15 (Riordan PGY7, Zyck PGY1).
gap_details.2015-2016: cnyneurosurgery.org kept the 2014-15 list (relabelled 'as of March 2015') in every capture to 2016-06-29; upstatebrainandspine.org first archived 2016-07 already with the 2016-17 list; CC 2015-2016 found nothing new. Reconstructed 11 incl. Rai/Goulart PGY1 (graduates page 2022). Ferrone PGY left null (PGY5 2014-15 and PGY6 2016-17). Simpson not reconstructed. PHASE 2: CC 2015-2016 re-run with current filter (cnyneurosurgery.org, upstatebrainandspine.org, upstate.edu/neurosurgery): only the stale 'as of March 2015' list. GME Resident Reports Fall 2014/Fall 2015/Spring 2016 OCR'd: award news only (Toshkezi NREF grant, Choi), no roster. Simpson departure 2015 or 2016 remains open.

gap_details.2025-2026: No capture of residents-fellows.php after 2025-06-19 (Wayback, all statuses) and none in Common Crawl 2025-2026 (21 crawls, only the Feb/Jun-2025 pages). Unobservable. problems: Live upstate.edu entirely behind Cloudflare (403), not bypassed; on the MANUAL-CHECK list. All Common Crawl crawls completed (2015-48 and 2026-39 after one retry). 2011-12, 2012-13 and 2015-16 remain reconstructed (low significance). 2025-26/2026-27 missing (significant).

2011-2012.reason: Complete 2011 intake known (GME Resident Report Fall 2011: Bodman, Ferrone); Jacobsen confirmed at Albany by Jan 2012; every other 2010-11 resident bracketed or on the graduates list.

2012-2013.reason: 2012 intake = Simpson + Toshkezi (both PGY2 in July 2013; 2/yr complement filled); only a 2012 intern who left within the year, or a same-year in/out transfer, could be missed.

2015-2016.reason: All cohorts bracketed by 2014-15 and 2016-17 plus graduates page; only open point is whether Simpson (-> Baylor) left in summer 2015 or 2016.

2025-2026.reason: No roster anywhere after 2025-06 (Wayback, Common Crawl 2025-2026, newsletters); the 2025 intern class and any 2025-26 departure are unobservable.

2026-2027.reason: Live page behind Cloudflare challenge (not bypassed); Joe Garcia (Pitt PGY4 2025-26) transfer-in lead rests on an earlier Google-sourced verification row, not on an allowed source.

resolved_hidden_gap_questions.name: David Ferrone
resolved_hidden_gap_questions.note: Not a hidden transfer: listed as a new Upstate neurosurgery resident in July 2011 (GME Fall 2011 welcome list). Rosters place him one PGY above the 2011 class (PGY4 2013-14, PGY5 2014-15) with a non-advancing year before PGY6 2016-17; graduated 2018 after 7 years at Upstate. The adjudicator dates his entry to 2010 by PGY arithmetic; actual Upstate start was 2011.
